text: Based on cybernetics, information theory and system theory, control science studies common problems independent of specific objects in various fields, that is, how to describe and analyze objects and environmental information, and what kind of control and decision-making behavior to take in order to achieve certain goals. It has a general methodological significance for each specific application field, and the combination with the specific problems in each field forms a rich and diverse content of control engineering. This feature of this discipline makes it play a strong role in promoting the development of related disciplines, and shows outstanding vitality in the interdisciplinary and penetrating. For example, its integration with information science and computer science has opened up the fields of knowledge engineering and intelligent robotics. The combination of sociology and economics makes the research object enter the category of social system and economic system. The combination with biology and medicine has promoted the development of biological cybernetics more effectively. At the same time, the development of adjacent disciplines such as computer, communication, microelectronics and cognitive science has also promoted the new development of control science and engineering, so that the research field involved in this discipline has been expanded.
